verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Postman's own API (postman-docs-5, postman-docs-41) and a CLI (postman-probe-5) for programmatic access, and a feature to generate SDKs *from* user collections (postman-docs-4), but there is no evidence of officially maintained Postman SDKs (e.g., Node/Python/Go client libraries) that an AI-native developer could build against to integrate with Postman itself.
